# Audit runner: pre-review child with `inherited_pass` bypasses children-stage block and summary claims "all children in in_review/done"

Discovered during the audit of `CG-0MTV69NII000LW8I` (Tableau-Card-Engine) — `discovered-from:CG-0MTV69NII000LW8I`.

## Problem Statement
The audit runner can report **"Ready to close: Yes"** for a parent work item that has a **critical, pre-review-stage child** (e.g. an auto-triaged `test-failure` item at `intake_complete`), and the report summary falsely claims *"All children are in in_review or done stage."* This produces a false-positive closure verdict.

## Evidence (reproduction)
- Audited item: `CG-0MTV69NII000LW8I` (Tableau-Card-Engine), audit run 2026-09-20.
- The runner auto-executed the full suite (F3 cache-miss path). The unit vitest stage was **SIGKILLed (exit 137)**.
- The test skill triaged this into `CG-0MUA2UWY7002KUQR` — a **critical `test-failure` bug** created as a **child** of the audited item at `status: open`, `stage: intake_complete`.
- The runner then reported `Ready to close: Yes` with summary: *"All children are in in_review or done stage."*
- The persisted report's `## Children Status` **does** render the child as `CG-0MUA2UWY7002KUQR — open/intake_complete` with verdict `met` ("Inherited from parent pass") — directly contradicting the summary.

## Root Cause
- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` (~9855-9861, `if not parent_gaps:` branch): when the parent passes with no gaps, **every** child gets `cr["inherited_pass"] = True` and `cr["child_audit_ready"] = True` — with **no stage guard**. The only guard is `_child_content_changed`, which is false for a brand-new child.
- `audit_runner.py:4207`: `all_children_reviewed = all(c.get("stage") in ("in_review","done") or c.get("inherited_pass") ...)` — `inherited_pass` exempts a **pre-review** child from the blocking children-stage check.
- `audit_runner.py:4333`: the summary unconditionally appends *"All children are in in_review or done stage."* when `all_children_reviewed` is true, even when a child is actually at `intake_complete`/`idea`/`plan_complete`.

## Expected Behaviour
- A child in a pre-review stage (`idea`, `intake_complete`, `plan_complete`) MUST block parent closure, per the documented rule ("only pre-review stages block") and `SA-0MRL8W6V7006LH5I`.
- `inherited_pass` (parent-first pass-through, `SA-0MSKB6VJA005N43F`) must not exempt a pre-review child from the stage check — at minimum it must not apply to a child created during the audit run (auto-triaged `test-failure`).
- The summary text must be accurate: if any child is not in `in_review`/`done`, say so and produce "Ready to close: No".

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A parent with any non-deleted child in `idea`/`intake_complete`/`plan_complete` reports "Ready to close: No" and names the blocking child, regardless of `inherited_pass`.
- [ ] `inherited_pass` is only applied to children in `in_review`/`done` (or explicitly exempted with a documented rationale), never to pre-review children.
- [ ] The summary's "All children are in in_review or done stage." line is only emitted when that is actually true; otherwise it names the blocking children.
- [ ] Regression test: auditing a parent whose child sits at `intake_complete` (with `inherited_pass` otherwise set) yields "Ready to close: No".

## Secondary observation (may warrant a follow-up item)
- AC5 ("Full project test suite must pass") was marked `met` by the Phase 1 model even though the runner's own suite execution was killed (exit 137). The documented fail-open semantics say execution-dependent ACs should stay `partial` on a red/error run. Confirm whether a red/killed run must force `partial` on execution-dependent ACs.

## Related Work
- `SA-0MRW0G0XZ009TU6E` — Audit runner circular dependency (child verdict blocks parent regardless of stage) — completed; the inverse problem.
- `SA-0MRL8W6V7006LH5I` — If a child audit is not ready to close then the parent must also be marked not ready to close — completed.
- `SA-0MSKB6VJA005N43F` — parent-first pass-through (`inherited_pass`).

## Key Files
- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` — ~4201-4214 (children-stage check), ~4333 (summary text), ~9855-9861 (`inherited_pass` assignment).
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **SA-0MRW0G0XZ009TU6E** – [CRITICAL] Audit runner has circular dependency — child audit verdict blocks parent regardless of stage (completed)
- **SA-0MSPPIC4P00849VK** – create_quality_epics.py (code-review + code_review): exact-title LIKE query (completed)
- **SA-0MQNR1I92004Z03R** – IntakeAll error recovery fails on abort, leaving items in completed+idea (contradictory state) (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` — matched: 0mskb6vja005n43f, ac5, acceptance, acs, actually (+139 more)
- `docs/dev/audit-skill-reference.md` — matched: 0mskb6vja005n43f, ac5, acceptance, acs, actually (+124 more)
- `skill/audit/SKILL.md` — matched: acceptance, acs, actually, also, appends (+115 more)
